theorems.name: store_only_connected
theorems.doc: (S) A setup is stored in NVS only after it connected, and only if no newer setup was submitted meanwhile: a wrong password, an unknown network, an unparsable or rejected setup is never stored (so a bad setup can not survive a reset and keep the device off the network).
theorems.statement:
theorem store_only_connected (st : Prov) (a : Attempt) {st' r}
    (h : attempt st a = ok (st', r)) :
    r.store = true → st.pending = false ∧ a.parsed = true ∧ a.driver_ok = true ∧ a.connected = true ∧
      st'.status = Status.Connected
theorems.proof:
theorem store_only_connected (st : Prov) (a : Attempt) {st' r}
    (h : attempt st a = ok (st', r)) :
    r.store = true → st.pending = false ∧ a.parsed = true ∧ a.driver_ok = true ∧ a.connected = true ∧
      st'.status = Status.Connected := by
  unfold attempt at h
  revert h
  cases ht : st.trying <;> cases hp : st.pending <;> cases a.parsed <;> cases a.driver_ok <;> cases a.connected <;>
    simp_all <;> (try (intro h1 h2; subst h1 h2; simp_all))

theorems.name: ip_only_when_connected
theorems.doc: (S) `/status` shows the station address only when connected.
theorems.proof:
theorem ip_only_when_connected (st : Prov) {w s ip}
    (h : http st .Status = ok (w, Resp.Status s ip)) :
    ip = true → s = Status.Connected ∧ st.status = Status.Connected ∧ st.has_ip = true := by
  unfold http is_connected at h
  revert h
  cases hs : st.status <;> cases st.has_ip <;> simp_all <;> (try (intro h1 h2 h3; subst_vars; simp_all)) <;>
    (try (intro h1; subst_vars; simp_all))

theorems.name: end_only_connected
theorems.doc: (S) Provisioning (the open AP) ends only after a connection.
theorems.statement:
theorem end_only_connected (st : Prov) (g : Bool) {st'}
    (h : «end» st g = ok st') : st'.ended = true → st.ended = true ∨ st.status = Status.Connected
theorems.proof:
theorem end_only_connected (st : Prov) (g : Bool) {st'}
    (h : «end» st g = ok st') : st'.ended = true → st.ended = true ∨ st.status = Status.Connected := by
  unfold «end» is_connected at h
  revert h
  cases hs : st.status <;> cases st.connected_seen <;> cases g <;> simp_all <;> (try (intro h; subst h; simp_all))

theorems.name: invalid_never_stored
theorems.doc: (S) An invalid setup (unparsable, or rejected by the driver) is reported as `failed:invalid` and never stored.
theorems.proof:
theorem invalid_never_stored (st : Prov) (a : Attempt) (ht : st.trying = true) (hp : st.pending = false)
    (hi : a.parsed = false ∨ a.driver_ok = false) {st' r}
    (h : attempt st a = ok (st', r)) : r.store = false ∧ st'.status = Status.Invalid := by
  unfold attempt at h
  revert h hi
  cases a.parsed <;> cases a.driver_ok <;> cases a.connected <;> simp [ht, hp] <;>
    (try (intro h1 h2; subst h1 h2; simp))

theorems.name: setup_starts_connecting
theorems.doc: (S) A submitted setup sets the status to `connecting` (the panel never reads the previous attempt's result as this one's).
theorems.statement:
theorem setup_starts_connecting (st : Prov) (hs : st.stored = false) :
    http st (.Setup true) = ok (some { st with status := Status.Connecting, pending := true }, Resp.SetupTaken)
theorems.proof:
theorem setup_starts_connecting (st : Prov) (hs : st.stored = false) :
    http st (.Setup true) = ok (some { st with status := Status.Connecting, pending := true }, Resp.SetupTaken) := by
  simp [http, hs]

theorems.name: oversized_setup_ignored
theorems.statement:
theorem oversized_setup_ignored (st : Prov) (hs : st.stored = false) :
    http st (.Setup false) = ok (none, Resp.SetupTooLarge)
theorems.proof:
theorem oversized_setup_ignored (st : Prov) (hs : st.stored = false) :
    http st (.Setup false) = ok (none, Resp.SetupTooLarge) := by
  simp [http, hs]

theorems.name: unparsable_stored_deleted
theorems.doc: (S) A stored setup that does not parse is deleted (a corrupt entry can not make every boot fail).
theorems.statement: theorem unparsable_stored_deleted : load_setup true false = ok Stored.Delete
theorems.proof:
theorem unparsable_stored_deleted : load_setup true false = ok Stored.Delete := by
  simp [load_setup]

theorems.name: ota_needs_params
theorems.doc: (S) An upload begins only with its size, CRC and length.
theorems.statement:
theorem ota_needs_params (s c l : Bool) :
    ota_begin s c l = ok Ota.Begin ↔ (s = true ∧ c = true ∧ l = true)
theorems.proof:
theorem ota_needs_params (s c l : Bool) :
    ota_begin s c l = ok Ota.Begin ↔ (s = true ∧ c = true ∧ l = true) := by
  unfold ota_begin; cases s <;> cases c <;> cases l <;> simp

theorems.name: ota_reset_only_verified
theorems.doc: (S) The device resets into an uploaded image only if every write succeeded, the image is complete and it verified.
theorems.statement:
theorem ota_reset_only_verified (w c v : Bool) :
    ota_end w c v = ok OtaEnd.Reset ↔ (w = true ∧ c = true ∧ v = true)
theorems.proof:
theorem ota_reset_only_verified (w c v : Bool) :
    ota_end w c v = ok OtaEnd.Reset ↔ (w = true ∧ c = true ∧ v = true) := by
  unfold ota_end; cases w <;> cases c <;> cases v <;> simp

theorems.name: reads_change_nothing
theorems.doc: (S) Requests other than `/setup` and a connected `/status` change nothing.
theorems.proof:
theorem reads_change_nothing (st : Prov) (q : Req)
    (hq : q = .Panel ∨ q = .UpdatePanel ∨ q = .List ∨ q = .OtherGet ∨ q = .Other) {w r}
    (h : http st q = ok (w, r)) : w = none := by
  rcases hq with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp [http] at h <;> simp_all

theorems.name: no_attempt_without_setup
theorems.doc: (C) The worker reports nothing unless it is trying a setup.
theorems.statement:
theorem no_attempt_without_setup (st : Prov) (a : Attempt) (ht : st.trying = false) :
    attempt st a = ok (st, { store := false, will_end := false })
theorems.proof:
theorem no_attempt_without_setup (st : Prov) (a : Attempt) (ht : st.trying = false) :
    attempt st a = ok (st, { store := false, will_end := false }) := by
  simp [attempt, ht]

theorems.name: superseded_not_stored
theorems.doc: (S) An attempt overtaken by a newer submission reports nothing, stores nothing and does not end provisioning: `/status` keeps saying `connecting` for the newer setup.
theorems.proof:
theorem superseded_not_stored (st : Prov) (a : Attempt) (hp : st.pending = true) {st' r}
    (h : attempt st a = ok (st', r)) :
    r.store = false ∧ r.will_end = false ∧ (st.trying = true → st'.status = Status.Connecting) := by
  unfold attempt at h
  revert h
  cases ht : st.trying <;> simp [hp] <;> (try (intro h1 h2; subst h1 h2; simp_all))

theorems.name: take_only_pending
theorems.doc: (C) The worker takes a setup only when one was submitted, and then reports `connecting`.
theorems.statement:
theorem take_only_pending (st : Prov) {st'} (h : take st = ok (some st')) :
    st.pending = true ∧ st'.status = Status.Connecting ∧ st'.trying = true ∧ st'.pending = false
theorems.proof:
theorem take_only_pending (st : Prov) {st'} (h : take st = ok (some st')) :
    st.pending = true ∧ st'.status = Status.Connecting ∧ st'.trying = true ∧ st'.pending = false := by
  unfold take at h
  revert h
  cases hp : st.pending <;> simp <;> (intro h; subst h; simp)

theorems.name: setup_after_connect_refused
theorems.doc: (S) Once a setup connected and was stored, a later setup is refused and changes nothing: it can neither replace the stored one nor keep the AP up.
theorems.statement:
theorem setup_after_connect_refused (st : Prov) (f : Bool) (hs : st.stored = true) :
    http st (.Setup f) = ok (none, Resp.SetupRefused)
theorems.proof:
theorem setup_after_connect_refused (st : Prov) (f : Bool) (hs : st.stored = true) :
    http st (.Setup f) = ok (none, Resp.SetupRefused) := by
  simp [http, hs]

theorems.name: connected_stays_until_end
theorems.doc: (L) After the connection, no request moves the status off `connected` (so `end` fires: the AP goes down).
theorems.statement:
theorem connected_stays_until_end (st : Prov) (q : Req) (hs : st.stored = true)
    (hc : st.status = Status.Connected) {st' r} (h : http st q = ok (some st', r)) :
    st'.status = Status.Connected ∧ st'.stored = true
theorems.proof:
theorem connected_stays_until_end (st : Prov) (q : Req) (hs : st.stored = true)
    (hc : st.status = Status.Connected) {st' r} (h : http st q = ok (some st', r)) :
    st'.status = Status.Connected ∧ st'.stored = true := by
  unfold http at h
  cases q <;> simp [hs, hc, is_connected] at h <;> (try (obtain ⟨h1, _⟩ := h; subst h1; simp [hs, hc]))

Prov.lean:
structure Prov where
  status : Status
  has_ip : Bool
  connected_seen : Bool
  pending : Bool
  trying : Bool
  stored : Bool
  ended : Bool
Prov.upstream_note: the provisioning state WmInnerSignals carries (status, the pending setup, connected-seen, the end)

Resp.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Resp where
| Panel : Resp
| UpdatePanel : Resp
| List : Resp
| Status : Status → Bool → Resp
| SetupTaken : Resp
| SetupTooLarge : Resp
| SetupRefused : Resp
| Redirect : Resp
| NotFound : Resp

Stored.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Stored where
| Absent : Stored
| Use : Stored
| Delete : Stored
Stored.upstream_note: what load_wifi_setup finds: none, a setup, one that does not parse

ota_begin.lean:
def ota_begin
  (has_size : Bool) (has_crc : Bool) (has_len : Bool) : Result Ota := do
  if has_size
  then
    if has_crc
    then if has_len
         then ok Ota.Begin
         else ok Ota.BadRequest
    else ok Ota.BadRequest
  else ok Ota.BadRequest

Status.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Status where
| Idle : Status
| Connecting : Status
| Connected : Status
| Invalid : Status
| Failed : Status

Ota.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Ota where
| BadRequest : Ota
| Begin : Ota
Ota.upstream_note: POST /update's outcomes before the body (missing size, crc or length; ota begin failing)

attempt.lean:
def attempt (st : Prov) (a : Attempt) : Result (Prov × AfterAttempt) := do
  if st.trying
  then
    if st.pending
    then
      ok ({ st with status := Status.Connecting, trying := false },
        { store := false, will_end := false })
    else
      if a.parsed
      then
        if a.driver_ok
        then
          if a.connected
          then
            ok
              ({
                 st
                   with
                   status := Status.Connected,
                   has_ip := a.got_ip,
                   trying := false,
                   stored := true
               }, { store := true, will_end := true })
          else
            ok ({ st with status := Status.Failed, trying := false },
              { store := false, will_end := false })
        else
          ok ({ st with status := Status.Invalid, trying := false },
            { store := false, will_end := false })
      else
        ok ({ st with status := Status.Invalid, trying := false },
          { store := false, will_end := false })
  else ok (st, { store := false, will_end := false })
attempt.upstream_note: one turn of wifi_connection_worker's loop; the port drops an attempt superseded by a newer setup (U1)

load_setup.lean:
def load_setup (present : Bool) (parses : Bool) : Result Stored := do
  if present
  then if parses
       then ok Stored.Use
       else ok Stored.Delete
  else ok Stored.Absent

AfterAttempt.lean:
structure AfterAttempt where
  store : Bool
  will_end : Bool
AfterAttempt.upstream_note: what follows an attempt: the status, storing the setup, ending provisioning

Attempt.lean:
structure Attempt where
  parsed : Bool
  driver_ok : Bool
  connected : Bool
  got_ip : Bool
Attempt.upstream_note: one connection attempt's inputs: the setup parses, the driver connects

Req.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Req where
| Panel : Req
| UpdatePanel : Req
| List : Req
| Status : Req
| Setup : Bool → Req
| OtherGet : Req
| Other : Req

OtaEnd.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive OtaEnd where
| Reset : OtaEnd
| VerifyFailed : OtaEnd
| Incomplete : OtaEnd
| WriteFailed : OtaEnd
OtaEnd.upstream_note: the upload's end: written, complete, verified

take.lean:
def take (st : Prov) : Result (Option Prov) := do
  if st.pending
  then
    ok (some
      { st with status := Status.Connecting, pending := false, trying := true })
  else ok none
take.upstream_note: the connection worker taking the submitted setup (wifi_conn_info_sig) and reporting connecting

is_connected.lean:
def is_connected (s : Status) : Result Bool := do
  match s with
  | Status.Idle => ok false
  | Status.Connecting => ok false
  | Status.Connected => ok true
  | Status.Invalid => ok false
  | Status.Failed => ok false
is_connected.upstream_note: port-only helper over SetupStatus: whether it is Connected

http.lean:
def http (st : Prov) (req : Req) : Result ((Option Prov) × Resp) := do
  match req with
  | Req.Panel => ok (none, Resp.Panel)
  | Req.UpdatePanel => ok (none, Resp.UpdatePanel)
  | Req.List => ok (none, Resp.List)
  | Req.Status =>
    let connected ← is_connected st.status
    let show_ip ← if connected
                    then ok st.has_ip
                    else ok false
    if connected
    then
      ok (some { st with connected_seen := true }, Resp.Status st.status
        show_ip)
    else ok (none, Resp.Status st.status show_ip)
  | Req.Setup fits =>
    if st.stored
    then ok (none, Resp.SetupRefused)
    else
      if fits
      then
        ok (some { st with status := Status.Connecting, pending := true },
          Resp.SetupTaken)
      else ok (none, Resp.SetupTooLarge)
  | Req.OtherGet => ok (none, Resp.Redirect)
  | Req.Other => ok (none, Resp.NotFound)
http.upstream_note: handle_request, as a decision over the provisioning state; the port refuses a setup after one connected (U1)

ota_end.lean:
def ota_end
  (write_ok : Bool) (complete : Bool) (verified : Bool) : Result OtaEnd := do
  if write_ok
  then
    if complete
    then if verified
         then ok OtaEnd.Reset
         else ok OtaEnd.VerifyFailed
    else ok OtaEnd.Incomplete
  else ok OtaEnd.WriteFailed
